title: Contribution of Dysregulated Metabolic Signature in HIV-associated Immune Reconstitution Inflammatory Syndrome
description: In this study, we sought to evaluate the metabolic perturbations in IRIS across longitudinal time points using an unbiased plasma metabolomics approach as well as integrated analyses to include plasma inflammatory biomarker profile and whole blood transcriptome Overall design: Different expression between IRIS and Non IRIS patients prospectively
